resources.string: Check in with someone you know.
Invite one person. Check in on any three days this week, even when you change your plans. Your partner can join in or cheer you on.

Your partner sees your chosen name, role, check-in days, preset messages and whether you ask for another week. Your planned days, fasting timer, health logs and reasons for checking in stay on this phone.
You can accept an invitation to cheer someone on. This role never asks you to fast.
This invitation link is incomplete. Ask your partner to share the full link.
This invitation is unavailable. Check your connection or ask for a fresh link.
You already have a partner week on this phone. To use a new invitation, leave the current week first.
Your seven days begin when you join. Choose how you would like to take part.
Choose any three days to check in.
Send encouragement whenever you like. You do not need to fast or check in.
Send this private invitation to one person. The first person to accept it will become your partner for the week.
Join me for a partner week on Fasting Shift. You can check in with me or cheer me on. %1$s
Your shared week ends for both people. Your personal fasting history stays on this phone.
Anyone who has this link will no longer be able to join.
You can check in on a fasting day, a rest day or a day you stop early.
Saved on this phone. Your check-in will be shared when you reconnect.
Showing the latest week saved on this phone.
You made time for each other this week.
You’ve asked to do another week together. Your partner can join when they’re ready.
Your partner would like to do another week together.
You’ve left on this phone. Reconnect to close the shared week for both people.
Partner weeks are available to adults aged 18 and over.
